sentences.text: The CJC commissioned Project Triton to investigate allegations that public officials had obstructed or mishandled investigations of child sexual abuse.
sentences.support: the Project Triton investigation is concerned with whether police officers have failed to investigate certain allegations of such activities or covered them up

sentences.text: The inquiry examined claims about secret police files, alleged films of child abuse and murder, earlier police investigations and cases in the Whitsundays.
sentences.support: allegations concerning the possible existence of two further ‘snuff’ movies have been investigated.

sentences.text: The inquiry rejected the cover-up and impropriety allegations considered under its first four references.
sentences.support: Those allegations received widespread and prominent publicity; yet, upon investigation, not one allegation had substance in fact.

sentences.text: The inquiry found no basis to suspect police protection of offenders in the Whitsundays and concluded that allegations about the films had been properly investigated.
sentences.support: There is no basis to suspect that police have protected paedophiles from detection and punishment.

findings.quote: Allegations made to law enforcement and other agencies in Queensland suggesting the existence of ‘snuff’ movies have been properly investigated and suggestions that such investigations were aborted or interfered with are baseless.
There is no basis to suspect that police have protected paedophiles from detection and punishment.

notes: No numbered recommendation list is present. The summary concerns official handling of allegations, not a finding that child sexual abuse did not occur. Findings about references 1–4 are distinguished from the separate complaint process under reference 5.
